module.name: notice
module.title: Notice
module.description: The Notice renderer and its options.

ui.name: notice
ui.summary: An in-page notice inside a form or card.
ui.guidance: Live decides how the message is announced, and the component owns the mapping so a caller cannot silently downgrade an actionable failure to a status. The default is LiveOff: a notice rendered as part of the page on first paint has nothing to announce, and marking it live makes a screen reader read it again on every unrelated update.
